spans.s: नद् (I) vi. (but often used with a cognate acc., e.g. ननाद, नादान्) 1P (pres. नदति, प्रणदति) 1. To sound, to resound, to thunder, नदत्याकाशगंगायाः स्रोतस्युद्दामदिग्गजे R.i.78, Sis.v.63, Bt.ii.4; 2. to shout, to cry, to speak.With उद्-, to roar, to cry, K.S.i.56.With नि-, to sound, R.v.75.With प्र-, to sound, to resound, Sis.ix.71.With वि-, to sound, to resound.
नद् Caus. (नादयति-ते) 1. to fill with noise, to make resonant; 2. to cause to make sound.With वि-, to cause to utter notes,
Ghat.10

नद् (II) vi. 1P (pres. नंदति) To be glad, to be satisfied with, to be glad of anything, ननंदरुस्तौ R.ii.22, iii.11, 22, iv.3.With अभि-, 1. to be glad, to be satisfied, नाभिनंदति न द्वेष्टि Bg.ii.57; 2. to desire, to wish for, to like, नाभिनंदेत मरणं नाभिनंदेत जीवितम् M.vi.45; 3. to greet, to congratulate upon, तमभ्यनंदत् प्रथमं प्रबोधितः R.iii.68, vii.69, 71; 4. to praise, to approve of, ताः पितृभिश्चाभिनंदिताः Sak.iii.With आ-, to be glad, आनंदितारस्त्वां दृष्ट्वा Bt.xxii.14.With प्रति-, 1. to bless, K.S.vii.87; 2. to congratulate upon, M.ii.54.
नद् Caus. (नंदयति-ते) to gladden, to please, to make happy, सैव कुमुद्वती मे दृष्टिं न नंदयति संस्मरणीयशोभा Sak.iv., Bt.ii.16.With आ-, to gladden, to please, to make joyous, Yaj.i.356.
नद m. 1. A river, a great river; (Mall. commenting on Sis.iv.66 thus distinguishes between नद and नदी- प्राक्स्रोतसो नद्यः प्रत्यक्स्रोतसो नदा नर्मदां विनेत्याहुः) Sis.iv.66, M.vi.90; 2. the ocean.
नाद m. 1. A loud sound, cry, roaring, R.xii.79; 2. a sound in general; 3. the nasal sound represented by a semicircle (???) (in Yoga Phil.).
नद-राज m. the ocean.
नदथु m. Noise, roaring, especially the roaring of a bull.
नदी f. A river, any flowing water, नदीमिवांतः सलिलां सरस्वतीम् R.iii.9, M.vi.90.
नदी-इन, -कांत m. the ocean.
नदी-इन, -कांत m. the ocean.
नदी-कूलप्रिय m. a species of cane.
नदी-ज m. an epithet of Bhīṣma.
नदी-तरस्थान n. a landing place.
नदी-दोह m. freight, fare.
नदी-धर m. an epithet of Śiva.
नदी-पति m. 1. the ocean; 2. an epithet of Varuṇa.
नदी-पूर m. a river which has overflown its banks.
नदी-भव n. river-salt.
नदी-मातृक a. watered by rivers, irrigated (as a country.) See देवमातृक.
नदी-रय m. the current of a river.
नदी-वंक m. the bend or arm of a river.
नदी-ष्ण a. 1. bathing in rivers; 2. knowing the dangerous spots in rivers, their depth &c., ततः समाज्ञापयदाशु सर्वानानायिनस्तद्विचये नदीष्णान् R.xvi.75; (hence) 3. experienced, clever.
नदी-सर्ज m. the Arjuna tree.
नद्ध (I) a. (f. द्धा) 1. Tied, fastened, joined; 2. covered, embroidered, interwoven.
नद्ध (II) n. A tie, a knot.
नद्ध (I) a. (f. द्धा) 1. Tied, fastened, joined; 2. covered, embroidered, interwoven.
नद्ध्री f. A leather strap.
नादिन् a. (f. नी) 1. Sounding, resonant, R.iii.59, xix.5; 2. bellowing, roaring.
नादिन् a. (f. नी) 1. Sounding, resonant, R.iii.59, xix.5; 2. bellowing, roaring.
नादेय (I) a. (f. यी) River-born, aquatic, marine.
नादेय (II) n. Rock-salt.
नादेय (I) a. (f. यी) River-born, aquatic, marine.
